moment: Ending at the Ladakh lake: yellow scooter on the pebble shore, circled and ticked
why: Yellow scooter beside a mirror-still Himalayan lake is the signature last scene of 3 Idiots.

moment: Home-built camera quadcopter hovering in a stone-and-concrete college courtyard
why: Brutalist Indian campus colonnades plus a DIY camera drone match the 3 Idiots campus and its drone scene; could also just be 'drone on a campus'.

moment: Same drone over the campus lawn, pergola corridor at left
why: Same reading as J036.

moment: Floating candles in a night sky with one candle caught in teal targeting brackets
why: Floating candles are the Great Hall motif; the bracket reticle is a UI/game overlay, not film.

moment: Wanted/bounty posters nailed to a weathered board, one blank poster foregrounded
why: Frontier wanted-poster board fits RDR2, but it is a generic western prop.

moment: Gang camp at sunset: horses at a rail, covered wagon, campfire cookpot, tents above a lake
why: Very close to RDR2's lakeside Horseshoe Overlook camp.

moment: Night camp: two tents and a campfire under dark hills
why: Mood fits RDR2 camp life, but the image alone is a generic campsite.

moment: Storm-dark sea with a treasure-map route from compass past a skull to an X
why: The sea photo is generic and very dark at this width; the compass/skull/X chart carries the pirate reading.

moment: Marauder's Map: creased parchment corridors, walking footprints, ribbon label
why: Footprints walking along inked corridors on folded parchment is the Marauder's Map.

moment: Golden-hour frontier valley with a winding river and a lone grazing horse
why: Painterly American West vista with a horse; RDR2-like, no unique landmark.

moment: Stone lecture hall with a chalk quadcopter, gear and flight curve on the board
why: Stone-walled Indian classroom, wooden tiers and a drone sketch evoke the 3 Idiots classrooms.

moment: Framed golden valley with grazing horse; a faint aim line across the bottom
why: Same frontier vista as J028 inside a card frame.

moment: Parchment on a candlelit floor, ink veins spreading from its centre, footprints, castle through the windows
why: Floating candles, castle outside and footprints on parchment place it at Hogwarts (map/diary revealing ink).

moment: Arthur Morgan's journal: crossed-out grid, lake, pines, saddled horse, red pencil underline
why: Graphite sketchbook spread with horse and taped note mirrors the RDR2 journal.

moment: Virus's astronaut pen in a velvet box beside a stopwatch on a classroom desk
why: The presentation-boxed 'astronaut' pen plus stopwatch is the 3 Idiots director's prized pen and time obsession.

moment: Marauder's Map header: ribbon banner, corner seals, ruled corridors
why: Same Marauder's Map parchment; no footprints in this crop so slightly lower.

moment: Moonlit harbour with tall ships at a lantern-lit quay (Port Royal / Tortuga) above a treasure-map route
why: Colonial harbour with masted ships plus compass and X route; the end marker here is a sun/face medallion rather than a skull.

moment: Floating candles in a starfield, rows divided by faint rules
why: Floating candles motif; mostly background texture.

moment: Blood-red ranch sunset with X target marks tagged in the sky (Dead Eye)
why: Red-graded ranch, fence, mountains and Dead Eye-style X tags.

moment: Dusk camp: lantern-lit wall tent, cookpot over fire, wagon edge, peaks
why: The canvas wall tent and cookpot camp is RDR2 camp iconography.

moment: Darkened ghost ship behind Jack's compass with a dotted course line
why: Ghost-ship silhouette and octagonal compass; very dark frame.

moment: Journal spread: sketched ladder/bridge, lake, pines, saddled horse, taped note
why: Arthur Morgan sketchbook style.

moment: Astronaut pen and stopwatch on the desk, alternate framing
why: Same reading as J023.

moment: Hogwarts Great Hall at night with floating candles
why: Unmistakable Great Hall.

moment: Ghost ship with tattered sails under the moon and Jack Sparrow's compass
why: Black Pearl/Flying Dutchman-style galleon plus the hinged octagonal compass.

moment: Enchanted Great Hall ceiling: candles floating against stars and cloud
why: Candles hanging in a starry sky is the Great Hall ceiling.

moment: Ghost ship in a storm with a gold dotted trail ending in an X on the water
why: Tattered sails, fog and a treasure-map trail.

moment: Sunset ocean, ship on the horizon with glowing wake; compass-skull-X route below
why: Pirate chart carries it; the seascape is generic.

moment: Night sea with a bioluminescent wave, distant ship, compass riding the swell
why: Ship on the horizon + Jack's compass; the sea alone is generic.

moment: Stone lecture hall with quadcopter chalk drawing above the lecturer's bench
why: Same classroom as J027.

moment: Hogwarts Express crossing the Glenfinnan Viaduct
why: Red steam train on the curved stone viaduct over a Highland loch.

moment: Chalkboard with a drone and a bar chart in a sunlit room with a gothic arched window
why: Drone on the board says 3 Idiots, but the carved sandstone arch reads more Hogwarts/Oxford. Mixed signals.

moment: Hogwarts across the Black Lake at night with a broomstick and floating candles
why: Castle silhouette, broomstick, candles, lake reflections.

moment: Yellow scooter at the Ladakh lake, a row of drawn boxes with one circled above
why: Same 3 Idiots finale imagery as J037.

moment: Night sea, glowing wave, distant ship, compass on the crest
why: Same as J009.

moment: Hogwarts Great Hall, floating candles, long tables
why: Unmistakable Great Hall.

moment: Red-sky ranch with crows and an aim line threading four X targets (Dead Eye)
why: Ranch plate plus a Dead Eye 'paint and fire' line.
